headline: President Nawrocki, in a special address, announced he signed the Tusk government's law
summary: Presidential spokesman Rafał Leśkiewicz said President Nawrocki signed the government's law on excess profits of fuel companies. The spokesman called it a victory of common sense over political calculation.
why: Windfall-profit rules on fuel companies affect the earnings and tax burden of refiners and fuel retailers operating in Poland.
